WallsSieges Description: Changes apply after a full game restart. More options: Mymod_settings.txt
ws_traits Description: Walls, moats, coastal towers and plaza paving are built only by kingdoms whose culture has the matching trait (Fortifications group). Turn off to build them everywhere, as before 1.2.
ws_camps Description: Armies set up camps with tents and siege guns near the besieged city.
ws_coast Description: Cities build small defence towers on the shore and stakes in the water.
ws_gates Description: Walls get gates that close when enemies approach.
ws_moat Description: Cities dig a moat outside the wall, with bridges at the gates.
ws_decay Description: Walls of shrinking or abandoned cities slowly crumble.
ws_news Description: Show world-log messages about walls and sieges.
ws_fx Description: Debris, smouldering beams, fire on battered gates and small pennants on towers during a siege.
ws_wall_share Description: Share of siege gun shots aimed at walls instead of gates (0 = gates only).
ws_gate_hp Description: Gate durability against siege guns. Default 900.
ws_reload Description: Siege gun reload time in seconds. Default 4.
ws_mountains Description: Walls, towers, moats and roads are not built on mountains.
ws_replan Description: When borders shift and walls end up on another kingdom's land, remove them and re-plan the wall along the new border. Restart needed.
ws_buffer Description: Experimental. Keep 2 tiles of space from other kingdoms when building on unclaimed land. Off by default. Restart needed.
ws_muster Description: When an enemy army marches on a city, half of the adults and all children gather in the centre before the siege starts.
ws_defenders Description: During a siege part of the city warriors take position at the gates under fire and at breaches in the wall.
ws_ram Description: A ram can appear in the enemy camp 10 seconds after it is set up (50%, one more try 10 seconds later). It heads for the closed gates, ignoring everyone, until the defenders destroy it.
ws_alert Description: Cities react to threats in steps: a patrol closes most gates, an army marching in gathers everyone in the centre, a siege locks everything. A flag in the city centre shows the level: green, yellow, red.
ws_sounds Description: Play the mod's own sounds (ram hits, gate creaks, impacts) from the Sounds folder. Off: game sounds only.
ws_sound_vol Description: Volume of the mod's own sounds. Default 60.
ws_mortar_min Description: The mortar will not fire at targets closer than this many tiles. Default 20.
ws_unstick Description: Nudge army units and marshals that hang near walls on the same task for too long.
ws_gun_range Description: Maximum range of siege guns in tiles. Default 56.
culture_trait_ws_walls_info: Kingdoms of this culture surround their cities with walls, gates and towers. Without this trait no new walls are built and old ones are not repaired.
culture_trait_ws_moat_info: Capitals dig a moat around the inner wall. Requires Wall Builders.
culture_trait_ws_coast_info: Cities build coastal towers and stakes at the shore. Requires Wall Builders.
culture_trait_ws_double_wall_info: The inner wall gets a second layer on the outside, between the wall and the moat. Requires Wall Builders.
culture_trait_ws_mortar_info: The siege camp of this kingdom always starts with a heavy mortar: huge reload, but the blast wrecks walls and buildings and leaves a big smouldering crater.
culture_trait_ws_paving_info: Capitals pave the central plaza with stone.
culture_trait_ws_rammers_info: The siege camp's ram always arrives 10 seconds after the camp; if it is destroyed, a new one comes with a 50% chance. The ram has 20% more health.
culture_trait_ws_iron_gates_info: The gates of this culture's cities have 50% more durability. Requires Wall Builders.
mod_siege_started: The siege of $1 has begun: the army of $2 has set up camp
mod_siege_lifted: The siege of $1 is lifted, the city has held
mod_siege_ruined: $1 has been wiped out and left empty, the siege is over
mod_fleet_sighted: A fleet of $2 has been sighted off the coast of $1
mod_wall_inner: $1 has surrounded itself with a defensive wall
mod_siege_fell: $1 has fallen, the surviving defenders surrendered to $2
ws_gossip_siege_1: Enemy soldiers are camped outside our walls. They say the army of $1 has brought siege engines.
ws_gossip_siege_2: I can hear the catapults at night. Stay away from the gate, friend.
ws_gossip_siege_3: They have pitched tents beyond the wall and lit their fires. We will not be leaving soon.
ws_gossip_mortar: Did you hear that thunder? $1 has dragged a mortar up to our walls. Stone will not save us from that.
ws_sc_start: The camp of $1 was set up at the walls of $2
ws_sc_closed: Gates barred, defenders on the walls
ws_sc_wall: A breach was made in the wall
